name: wrapup
description: Resolve concerns, cascade to shared docs, evaluate gate.

steps.name: Gather concerns
steps.instruction: Read CONCERNS.md. Filter open concerns referencing current entity (by refs or name). Include session-emitted concerns.

steps.name: Spec drift check
steps.instruction: Re-read entity docs (spec, logic doc). Compare field-by-field against what was built: count, types, edge cases, errors, naming vs GLOSSARY.md. Mismatches become concerns (type: issue). No docs: report skipped, continue.

steps.name: Resolve concerns
steps.instruction: For each concern: (1) read authoritative source, (2) write/run test to prove which side correct, (3) escalate only if ambiguous. Never skip to 3. Update spec, fix code, or both. Mark resolved in CONCERNS.md with date and decision. Recalculate summary header.

steps.name: Scope validation
steps.instruction: Verify completed work covers all 'in' items. Missing coverage = BLOCK concern. Verify obligation completion per routing policy. Coverage gaps prevent verified status.

steps.name: Cascade to shared docs
steps.instruction: Cascade resolutions: naming -> CONVENTIONS, scope -> SCOPE, dependencies -> ARCHITECTURE. Only cascade to docs that exist. Milestone concerns: offer archival.

steps.name: Evaluate gate and report
steps.instruction: Check gate: items remaining, conditions satisfied, blocking concerns. Blocking verdict is authoritative for /ship. Archive resolved if threshold exceeded. Report: '{entity}: {N} resolved, {M} escalated. Blocking: {list}. Gate: {X}/{Y} met.' Produce handoff packet: changes + requirements satisfied, data flow with boundaries, evidence table with blocked/untested claims.

engagement.override: cascade only fires for docs that exist

tone: Brief and mechanical. Resolve, cascade, report.
